core_candidate_provenance: Root proposed the fixed-data output-matrix extension; this worker independently reconstructed it.
operator_convention: L u_alpha = sum_{beta,i,j} C^{ij}_{alpha,beta} u_beta,ij; ordered spatial sum; C^{ij}=C^{ji}; no output symmetry assumed.
strong_parabolicity: sum a_alpha C^{ij}_{alpha,beta} a_beta xi_i xi_j >= lambda |a|^2 |xi|^2 for all real a,xi, with lambda>0

claims.statement: For every constant real generator with the stated coercivity, a common compact datum u0=(f,f^2), f=x+xy near zero, has det Du0=0 identically and initial determinant velocity 4 C^{11}_{22}>0 at zero.
claims.energy_consequence: E(0)=E'(0)=0, E''(0)=2 integral h^2>0, hence E'(t)>0 for sufficiently small t>0, where h=cof Du0:D Lu0.
domains: R^2 with compact datum and Schwartz solution
any fixed flat two-dimensional torus using a compact coordinate patch
claims.scope: All constant strongly parabolic output-matrix principal generators under the explicit coercive definition.

claims.statement: For every nonzero homogeneous constant second-order planar operator, some compact rank-one-gradient u0 has h=cof Du0:D Lu0 nonzero and v_s=u0+sLu0 has integral Q_C(Dv_s,D2v_s)<0 for sufficiently small s>0. Universal nonnegative integrated Q_C holds if and only if L=0. No correction N with integral N[v]=0 for every admissible compatible v can make Q_C+N pointwise nonnegative for every v.
claims.proof_dependency: Tangency classification, pure algebra, compact differentiation, and integration by parts; parabolicity and PDE solution existence are not required.

claims.statement: A homogeneous constant second-order planar operator is universally tangent to det Du=0 on every smooth compact rank-one-gradient map if and only if its effective spatial-symmetric coefficients all vanish.
qualifications: universal over all maps and all curve tangents/curvatures
classification concerns gradient rank, not merely preservation of a particular fixed target line

claims.statement: For C1 autonomous coefficients C(u,Du) with coercively strongly parabolic C(0,0), data epsilon(f,f^2) have initial determinant velocity 4 epsilon^2 C^{11}_{22}(0,epsilon E11) + 2 epsilon^3 partial_A11(C^{12}_{21}+C^{11}_{22})(0,epsilon E11) = 4 epsilon^2 C^{11}_{22}(0,0)+O(epsilon^3)>0.
excluded_from_this_corollary: explicit x-dependent coefficients with the same fixed datum

claims.statement: For every integer n>=2, the constant strongly parabolic determinant-square obstruction holds on R^n->R^n by u0=(f,f^2,g3,...,gn), f=x1+x1x2 and gk=xk near zero, with compact cutoff. The velocity is again 4 C^{11}_{22}.

not_claimed: negative quasiconvex energy or a Morrey counterexample
historical novelty or exhaustive prior-art clearance
failure of every nonlinear, degenerate, nonlocal, auxiliary, or changed-energy flow
